blocks.raw: <Note>SPP 203 (Specialized Allied Services) uses different methods depending on the specific service: Architectural Interiors uses percentage of work cost, Acoustic Design Services depends on work complexity, Site Development Planning uses estimated civil work cost, and Comprehensive Design and Planning uses MDPE.</Note>

blocks.raw: <Tip>Remember the MDPE formula as **"MRM + R"**: Manhours × Rate × Multiplier, plus Reimbursables. The multiplier (1.5–2.5) covers overhead and profit — it is NOT a separate line item.</Tip>
